claim_traceability.rationale: The missing /item_flows/2 (F_CONTACT) citation is now present, and every current ID-bearing SJS element has citation coverage, including the caliper action/steps. Citation passages support their respective assertions.

textbook_application.rationale: Context/interface modeling guidance is used consistently with distinguishing system elements from context. Textbook guidance is not used as evidence for patent facts; no design choice is inferred from it.
